Two-night minimum for weekend dates May through mid-October at Hermit Park; 14 nights in any 30 days across the county system. Park office 970-619-4570.

note: Larimer County open space ~2 mi SE of Estes Park, 7,880-8,964 ft, ponderosa forest and meadows; no water recreation on site (Lake Estes is 3 mi away). Bobcat (campground #2) is the RV campground; Hermit's Hollow (#1) sites cap at 20 ft, Kruger (#3) is equestrian. --Claude
summary: SPLIT CHECK done (see flags): four campgrounds, only Bobcat (39 sites, 25-45 ft) and tiny Granite Gulch (5 sites, 20-35 ft) take a 23-ft rig; Hermit's Hollow (42 sites) caps at 20 ft. Confirmed no hookups (non-electric, no site water/sewer); sites 108 (derived) -> 91 campsites (+13 cabins) with max 45 ft and pull-throughs; season Mar 1 - Dec 19 (closes Dec 20-Mar 1); booking ReserveAmerica (larimercamping.com), 180-day window, reservation required (no FCFS), 2-night weekend minimum May-mid-Oct, 14-night max; facilities vault toilets, seasonal water at 2 spigots, no showers, $15 dump. Fees re-read on the county permits page: $35/$45/$50 confirmed, $10/vehicle daily entrance permit added. Open now (county under reduced fire restrictions, not a ban).
